verdict.rationale: Fern exposes a documented, keyless public OpenAPI spec (openapi.json, 'Fern Public API') confirmed live via probe, plus an official CLI (npm fern-api) and MCP server that were both independently verified to work at runtime, giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: no independent (non-vendor) third-party writeup of the public API itself, and the llms.txt-advertised MCP endpoint path had a documented mismatch (404) requiring the alternate /learn/_mcp/server path.
